subject: Invoice appendix for Redwood Order Form — OrbitCloud
messages:
From: Jordan Marks <j.marks@orbitcloud.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orbitcloud.com, elaine.park@orbitcloud.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Invoice appendix for Redwood Order Form — OrbitCloud

Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — OrbitCloud is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to surface a short list of asks for the invoice appendix that we need included in the Order Form before we can complete the PO: 

- Standard monthly invoices to OrbitCloud APAC entity (Singapore) with currency SGD; US invoices only if we designate US entity as payer.
- Net60 payment terms (our standard).
- VAT / GST treatment: reverse-charge in EU, local GST handling in APAC.
- Withholding tax: OrbitCloud will need the ability to withhold where local law requires; we need a clawback/credit mechanism so Redwood credits withheld amounts against future invoices within 30 days of receipt of tax certificate.
- Minimum commit ramp: we are comfortable with a 3-quarter ramp (25% / 50% / 100%) but need the invoicing to reflect ramped commitment billing.
- PO and invoice numbering required on all invoices; ability to provide remittance details to our AP team.

Attached is the current Order Form (Orbit_Procurement_OrderForm_v3.pdf) with annotations. Can we get an invoice appendix draft and any redlines from legal by end of week?

Best,
Jordan
Procurement
OrbitCloud

---
Attachment: Orbit_Procurement_OrderForm_v3.pdf (pdf stub)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Jordan Marks <j.marks@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice appendix for Redwood Order Form — OrbitCloud

Jordan — thanks, and appreciate the clear list. Summary from our side and proposed compromises: 

- Invoicing entity: we can support APAC billing to Redwood Singapore entity. Finance needs the exact legal name and tax ID for the PO; can you share?
- Payment terms: internal ask is net30, but we can consider net45 for strategic deals. Net60 is difficult without an offset on pricing or extended commit ramp.
- Withholding/clawback: we agree to credit withheld amounts, but our legal needs to define acceptable evidence (official tax withholding certificate) and timing for the credit. Propose 60 days to apply credit after receipt.
- Minimum commit ramp: accept the 3-quarter ramp as a commercial construct. We will invoice based on committed units for each period; overages billed monthly. Proration rules need to be explicit (we propose pro rata by days in period).
- VAT/GST: we'll follow local tax handling; legal will add language for reverse-charge where applicable.

I've looped in Kimberly for legal redlines and Karthik for finance mapping. Kimberly — can you draft redline language for invoicing appendix (payment terms, clawback evidence, proration, and currency mapping)? Jordan — if you can send the Singapore legal entity + tax ID that would speed things.

Next steps: legal redline by end of Thu; commercial confirm on pricing tradeoffs if you require net60.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

---
Markus (on behalf of Redwood)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, Jordan Marks <j.marks@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice appendix redlines — draft attached

Markus / Jordan — attaching a focused redline doc (Invoice_Appendix_Redlines.docx) with proposed contract language. High level notes: 

1) Payment terms: propose "Net45" as a compromise. Net60 introduces cashflow risk; we can accept Net60 only with either (a) a 6% price increase on committed units for first year or (b) a short-term customer credit facility documented in an Addendum.

2) Withholding and clawback: Redwood will credit documented withholding taxes, provided OrbitCloud delivers a locally issued tax withholding certificate within 90 days of payment date. Credit to be applied to next invoice; if not applied within 180 days we will issue a refund after cross-check with accounting. 

3) Proration: define pro rata calculations by calendar day for partial periods; we propose an example calculation and a sample table in the appendix. 

4) Currency and entity: require the Order Form to include explicit invoice remit mapping (entity legal name, tax ID, currency, bank details). Finance will not accept generic wording.

5) Audit and evidence: Redwood reserves right to request supporting documentation for tax credits; provide a 30-day cure window if documents are contested.

6) PO / invoice numbering: acceptable and will be included as a field in the invoice template.

Jordan — please check items 1 and 2 above; if you accept Net45 we will insert the redline language and return for signature. If OrbitCloud insists on Net60, please indicate preferred commercial offset (price uplift or extended ramp).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Legal — Contracts & Commercials

---
Attachment: Invoice_Appendix_Redlines.docx (docx stub)

From: Jordan Marks <j.marks@orbitcloud.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orbitcloud.com, elaine.park@orbitcloud.com
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 02:48:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice appendix redlines — OrbitCloud position

Kimberly / Markus — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few points from OrbitCloud: 

- Net60 is our baseline for APAC procurement. We cannot accept Net45 without internal approvals that will delay signature. In exchange we can offer: a temporary 10% discount on committed units for months 1-3 OR an acceleration of the ramp (we could do 33% / 66% / 100% instead of 25/50/100) — pick one.
- Withholding: OrbitCloud will provide government-issued withholding certificates within 60 days; we can accept the 90-day requirement if Redwood expedites credits within 30 days after receipt of certificate (i.e., Redwood applies the credit within 30 days, not 60).
- Proration: agreed to pro rata; please include worked examples.
- Entity data: Singapore legal name and GST registration: OrbitCloud APAC Pte Ltd, UEN 202700123K, GST Reg 23-1234567. Please confirm the invoice recipient entity name for Redwood so we can prepare PO.

We are happy to sign quickly if we can keep Net60 and the 30-day credit application. If Redwood insists on Net45, we will need to escalate internally and that will add ~2 weeks.

Regards,
Jordan
